title: The Fear of the Lord
definition: The fear of the Lord is reverent awe, holy respect, and humble submission before God.
summary: To fear the Lord is not to run from Him in terror as His child, but to honor Him as holy, righteous, powerful, and worthy.
christFocus: Christ teaches His people to trust God, obey God, and worship Him above every fear.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: To fear the Lord is not to run from Him in terror as His child, but to honor Him as holy, righteous, powerful, and worthy.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
